notes: Feature 5 owns the first image-generation node implementation because Character Image is the first product image asset node.
This task deliberately shares the foundation with Prop / Asset and Scene Image source nodes so the canvas does not get three duplicated text-to-image implementations.
Scene Image as a full feature remains not complete until reusable scene asset references and persistence are implemented.
Prop asset persistence and the full Asset Library remain later feature scope.
Image-to-video work is explicitly out of scope for this task.

small_features.title: Implement SeedDream text-to-image graph foundation
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Users can generate a single image outcome node from Character Image, Prop / Asset, or Scene Image text prompts, with backend-confirmed SeedDream provider/model evidence and honest no-persistence labeling.
acceptance_criteria: Character Image, Prop / Asset, and Scene Image source nodes open the shared image editor with node-specific prompt defaults.
Generate posts to the local FastAPI backend and never exposes Doubao credentials in frontend code.
Backend SeedDream config uses DOUBAO_API_KEY, DOUBAO_BASE_URL, SEEDREAM_MODEL, and optional DOUBAO_HTTPS_PROXY.
Provider code exposes submitSeedreamWithRetry() and submitSeedreamGenerationOnce() wrappers.
A successful generation creates or updates one deterministic image outcome node on the canvas.
The image outcome node renders the returned image URL or image data and displays provider/model evidence.
AI modify or other unavailable image-node functions show a visible not-implemented message instead of silently pretending to work.
Verification covers backend provider/route tests, frontend tests, typecheck/build, and rendered interaction or E2E evidence.
